typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Receipt Code} as string,
		{Receipt Reason} as string,
		{Payment Method} as string,
		{Vendor Reference Id} as string,
		{Subscriber Id} as string,
		{Group Id} as string,
		{Billing Group Id} as string,
		{Billing period} as integer,
		Amount as string,
		{Check Number} as string,
		{Received Date} as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT       Receipt_Code     AS    "Receipt Code"   ,     Receipt_Reason   AS   "Receipt Reason" ,     Payment_Method   AS   "Payment Method" ,     Vendor_Reference_Id AS   "Vendor Reference Id",     Subscriber_Id       AS     "Subscriber Id"  ,     Group_Id            AS     "Group Id"    ,     Billing_Group_Id    AS  "Billing Group Id",     Billingperiod      AS   "Billing period",     Amount             AS   "Amount",     Check_Number       AS  "Check Number"    ,     Received_Date      AS   "Received Date"             FROM AGP.MM_TRANSFEROUT_TRANFERIN',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource select(mapColumn(
		{Receipt Code} = {Receipt Code},
		{Receipt Reason} = {Receipt Reason},
		{Payment Method} = {Payment Method},
		{Vendor Reference Id} = {Vendor Reference Id},
		{Subscriber Id} = {Subscriber Id},
		{Group Id} = {Group Id},
		{Billing Group Id} = {Billing Group Id},
		{Billing period} = {Billing period},
		Amount = Amount,
		{Check Number} = {Check Number},
		{Received Date} = {Received Date}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
